evals.query: Run my Appium test on a real Android device on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Uses https://hub.testingbot.com/wd/hub
Prefixes Appium capabilities with appium:
Puts realDevice: true inside tb:options, not under appium:
References the app as tb://APP_ID or a public URL
Reads credentials from environment variables

evals.query: How do I get my APK onto TestingBot for Appium testing?
expected_behavior: Uses the uploadFile MCP tool or POST /v1/storage
Explains the response returns a tb:// app URL
Says to pass it as appium:app
Suggests reusing the ID rather than re-uploading an unchanged build

evals.query: My Appium session on TestingBot fails to start with an invalid capabilities error
expected_behavior: Checks for missing appium: prefixes on vendor capabilities
Checks for TestingBot keys left outside tb:options
Explains Appium 2/3 reject unprefixed vendor capabilities
Does not immediately blame credentials

evals.query: I have an Espresso test suite, can I run it on TestingBot?
expected_behavior: Identifies this as App Automate, not Appium
Points at uploadAppAutomateApp / uploadAppAutomateTests / runAppAutomateTest
Notes the run is async and must be polled
Does NOT write Appium capabilities

evals.query: Test my mobile website on an iPhone with TestingBot
expected_behavior: Identifies this as browser testing, not an app test
Routes to Selenium or Playwright rather than Appium
Does NOT ask for an IPA

evals.query: Run my Appium tests on an iPhone on TestingBot
expected_behavior: Checks getDevices rather than naming a model from memory
Suggests a deviceName pattern like iPhone.* over an exact model
Uses XCUITest as automationName

evals.query: My Appium tests on TestingBot all show as incomplete
expected_behavior: Uses execute_script with tb:test-result=passed or failed
Mentions tb:test-name for the session name
Puts the call in teardown so it runs on failure

evals.query: My Appium test gets stuck on the Android location permission dialog
expected_behavior: Suggests appium:autoGrantPermissions: true
Does not suggest clicking the dialog by coordinates

evals.query: Can I test my Flutter app with Appium on TestingBot?
expected_behavior: Says the app must be built in debug or profile mode, not release
Mentions flutter_driver in dev_dependencies and enableFlutterDriverExtension before runApp
Flags that these are changes to the app, not the test

evals.query: Run my Appium test with a Spanish locale on iOS and Android
expected_behavior: Uses appium:locale
Uses es_ES for iOS and ES for Android
Notes that the two platforms take different formats

evals.query: Should I pin the Appium version for my TestingBot tests?
expected_behavior: Recommends leaving appiumVersion unset by default
Mentions tb:options.appiumVersion accepts latest, latest-1 or an explicit version
Notes Appium 3 prefixes security-flagged commands such as uiautomator2:adb_shell
